We are happy to announce that the SAA is organising a one-day side meeting before the 2026 European Population Conference (EPC) in Bologna, entitled **“Life Course Dynamics: Insights from Sequence Analysis”**.

The meeting will take place on **3 June 2026** (approx. 9 am – 5 pm).

More information on our [Events](../../../events.qmd) page.
